services.name: Jet Ski rental
services.desc: At Route 72 Waverunner & Kayak, we have variety and flexibility. Yamaha, Kawasaki, and SeaDoo jet skis are available, and all our rentals are high performance and run up to 50MPH+. We rent by the half hour and the full hour, so you have plenty of time to enjoy the beautiful waters in our large riding area. Long Beach Island is a mere 18 miles long- Route 72 is an easy jet ski rental company to locate from the southern or northern tip of LBI. Ride your jet ski over the waves while passing sandy beaches, pristine nature, or wide-open bay.
